results.title: Automated Contouring and Planning in Radiation Therapy
results.content: Assessment of clinical acceptability relies on finding relevant intermediate metrics focused on three main pillars: (1) quantitative comparison with manually drawn clinical contours or treatment plans, (2) qualitative subjective reviews by subject matter experts (i.e., radiation oncologists), and (3) ultimate measures of efficiency and (predicted) impact on tumor control or similar clinically meaningful outcomes.
